what: Step 18 `--no-truncate` / safety-net must skip every truncate branch in shared flush code
scenario_or_breakage: The plan prefers reusing `flush_execution_issues()` with `--no-truncate`, but the current function truncates on `already-flushed`, `no-records`, and successful `ok` paths.
